Messages.Author: D. O.
Messages.Body:
Question on the change of target card in Jyhad. Does this card just end the
combat at the point that it is played or does it end and nullify the combat at
that point <meaning, does it make it so that the combat never happened and no
damage was given or anything>? Also, the cardd does not give a time when it
can be played <ie. - before range is determined on the first round> does this
mean it can be used at any point during the resulting comabt after an action
is blocked? Thanks.
	Goblin@kaiwan.com

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:

I believe that "when a minion is blocked" is supposed to mean "once it's
been determined that the action is blocked, but before combat begins".
I will check on that.
